prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for adoption hint, adoption new flow, choose path hint, and home notifications, as each has only 1 test.
Path layout changes (choose_path, layout) can be helpful, producing 1 winning test (+5.5% after noise correction) across 3 tests.
Finish new screen changes (finish, new_screen) can be helpful, yielding 1 winning test (+2.0% after noise correction) across 3 tests.
Sign-in hint changes (sign_in, hint) can be helpful, with 1 winning test (+3.3% after noise correction) across 3 tests.
Home wait info changes (home, wait_info) and adoption redesign changes (adoption, redesign) showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Initial predictions in Round 1 were overly optimistic, but underpredicted winning tests in Round 2 (path layout) and Round 3 (finish new screen).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, hint: +0.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, new_flow: -4.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: -0.5% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

- choose_path, layout: +1.8% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -0.0% after noise correction, 3 test(s)

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Post Adoption Account Registration Flow: Move sign-in to take place after pet selection and adoption confirmation so users bond with their pet before being asked to create or link an account. (why: Sign-in currently happens before pet creation where users have little investment; placing it after adoption leverages ownership motivation to reduce drop-off.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Interaction Tutorial Screen: Add a dedicated interactive tutorial screen right before home intro that visually demonstrates how to hide, drag, and talk to the pet on the desktop. (why: Support receives multiple confusion complaints post-onboarding regarding how to control, hide, or interact with the pet once setup completes.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Guided Multi-Step Pet Customization Flow: Insert a new personality trait selection screen into the adoption flow before final certificate generation. (why: Adoption drops off significantly (60.9%); giving users interactive personality choices increases commitment and reduces abandonment during adoption.)
3: [choose_path, layout] Two-Column Path Choice Screen Layout: Update the path selection screen to use a side-by-side two-column layout contrasting instant ready-made pets with custom AI creation. (why: Path layout changes showed strong historic test gains (+5.5%), and mean path decision time is high (514s), indicating clear side-by-side comparison helps users decide faster.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Sync Hint: Add a prominent account sync reassurance hint below sign-in options explicitly explaining how returning users restore their existing pets. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing in again, making account sync clarity crucial.)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Generation Stage Checklist: Transform the waiting screen into a checklist layout displaying step-by-step progress and time estimates while desktop assets render. (why: Waiting step has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s; structured progress feedback reduces user anxiety and drop-off during long renders.)
6: [finish, copy] Desktop Arrival Greeting Copy Refresh: Rewrite the final welcome screen copy to clearly explain immediate next steps for finding and interacting with the desktop pet. (why: Support receives user confusion tickets after onboarding on how to locate and control pets on their desktop.)
